question: SWAP is related to 19-4-1-11 in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WEEK is related to 23-22-5-16. To which of the following is EXAM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ebbb0b55344d7280e907e70de627ffb95d22661a0b6add9e894b4800076fb86.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**The numbers are the positional values of the opposite letter of the given words.**

 
• SWAP is related to 19-4-1-11.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3574b036a0996fec3c686ab81ba145409ab944f71ad4b0f983b055332df3e457.png] 

 
• WEEK related to 23-22-5-16.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03bfcf8d07f5c7ce7c0969da6434aa8e86d54aa3424a1cd469b0cd6d62ea2a51.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• EXAM is related to :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/552a5d3dc7a3ea165a9d97f77f83c007fbc5e6f60458c346fc408724978c2d36.png] 

​Thus, Exam is related to 5-3-1-14.

Hence, the correct answer is** "5-3-1-14".**
